Title: Document 2
Content: Source: Felipe Guaman Poma de Ayala, Christian descendant of Inca nobles, `text(two)` pages from The `text(First)` New Chronicle and Good Government, an illustrated history of South America that Poma de Ayala sent to the King of Spain, circa `text(1615)`.

The page on the left shows Vari Viracocha Runa and Vari Viracocha Uarni, a mythical `text(first)` couple of humans created by the Inca god Viracocha. The page on the right shows Adam and Eve, the `text(first)` couple of humans in the Bible.
